summary: BIONIC™ Bug Fix Verification - All 4 reported issues have been RESOLVED. Tested base map theme switching (Voyager, Clair, Sombre, Satellite, OSM, Terrain), WMS panel ergonomics, and waypoint functionality.
passed_tests: ✅ Base map Voyager (Couleur) - CARTO @2x tiles load correctly with colorful style
✅ Base map Clair (Positron) - CARTO light gray theme loads with © CARTO attribution
✅ Base map Sombre (Dark) - CARTO dark theme loads with dark background
✅ Base map Satellite - Google mt1 satellite imagery loads with © Google attribution
✅ Base map OpenStreetMap - OSM tiles load with © OpenStreetMap contributors attribution
✅ Base map Terrain (Topo) - OpenTopoMap loads with relief/contours and © OpenTopoMap (CC-BY-SA) attribution
✅ WMS panel width is 288px (w-72) - compact as expected
✅ WMS panel has scroll area with max-height 280px
✅ Map occupies 78.4% of viewport width (~80% / 4 columns out of 5)
✅ No AJAX errors when zooming on Satellite theme (Google tiles replaced ESRI)
✅ Waypoint can be added via form and marker appears on map
✅ Waypoint count updates in header (1 waypoint)
✅ Export button appears when waypoints exist
✅ WMS sources available: OpenStreetMap (1), CanVec (3), USGS (1)
✅ Base map selector dropdown shows all 6 options with icons
critical_code_review_comments: WMSLayerSelector.jsx lines 787-895: Base map selector correctly removes old source/layer before adding new one
Base map configs use proper tile URLs: CARTO (@2x), Google mt1, OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap
Stadia Maps replaced with OpenTopoMap (no API key required)
ESRI World Imagery replaced with Google satellite (no CORS/AJAX errors)
TerritoryPage.jsx line 521: grid-cols-5 layout with map on col-span-4 (80%)
WMSLayerSelector.jsx line 741: w-72 max-h-[calc(100vh-250px)] for compact panel

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All 4 reported bugs fixed and verified

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 reported bugs have been fixed: 1) Base maps now use remove/add source/layer pattern instead of setTiles(), 2) Terrain uses OpenTopoMap (no Stadia API key needed), 3) WMS panel is compact (w-72, 280px scroll), 4) Satellite uses Google tiles (no ESRI AJAX errors). All 6 base map themes work correctly with proper attributions.
